ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey/black) across >90% of the visible surface with isolated high-intensity (white) pixels localized at distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark pigmentation across both visible lobes. Discrete high-contrast light grey/white focal spots are clustered along the trailing edge and distal tip of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped central depression with a sharp axial vertex dividing the two lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations. The right lobe trailing edge displays distinct, rounded protrusions (approximately 5-12 pixels in depth) creating a heavily irregular boundary. Left lobe trailing edge is moderately irregular with lower-amplitude peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The left lobe follows a linear-to-convex sweep from base to tip. The right lobe follows a broader convex curve terminating in a sharp, slightly reflexed tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity circular pixel groups located primarily at the right distal tip and along the serrated trailing edge boundaries.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme irregular jaggedness on the right trailing edge characterized by large, bulbous protrusions likely corresponding to parasitic colonization or trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent hook-like projection at the extreme distal tip of the right lobe with high-intensity white pigmentation contrast.
